items.name: bit-scanner
items.title: Bit Scanner
items.description: A zero-extra-dependency React loader that scans a six-bit hexagram in discrete steps.
items.author: yon2x2
items.docs: Import the default export from your components/loaders/bit-scanner file. The component requires React and includes its own CSS, reduced-motion behavior, and accessible status semantics.

items.name: cascade-loader
items.title: Cascade Loader
items.description: A zero-extra-dependency React loader that sends a stepped wave through a six-line state.
items.author: yon2x2
items.docs: Import the default export from your components/loaders/generated/cascade file. It includes the shared HexGlyph source, reduced-motion behavior, and accessible status semantics.
